job.description:

Contract role - Baseline Clearance required

About the Role

We are partnering with a leading Federal Government department seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to support the delivery, operation and continuous improvement of critical ICT infrastructure and secure network services.
This is an exciting opportunity for a highly capable engineer with a strong background in enterprise infrastructure, network services, security technologies and data centre operations. You will work across a complex environment supporting secure systems, virtual service environments, networking infrastructure and major ICT initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide technical expertise across infrastructure projects and operational environments.
  • Design, implement, maintain and enhance virtual service environments and supporting infrastructure.
  • Support secure network, gateway and data centre services.
  • Configure, deploy and maintain servers, virtual platforms and network infrastructure.
  • Deliver infrastructure upgrades, remediation activities and technology improvements.
  • Monitor system performance, capacity and availability across enterprise environments.
  • Support infrastructure lifecycle management and asset governance activities.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, project teams and external service providers.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, deployment guides and operational procedures.
  • Contribute to infrastructure planning, implementation and operational support activities nationwide.
Required Experience
  • Demonstrated experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering and operational support.
  • Strong networking expertise covering routing, switching and secured network environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale ICT infrastructure in government, enterprise or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Proven experience with infrastructure design, implementation and maintenance.
  • Strong troubleshooting, incident management and problem resolution capabilities.
  • Experience delivering technical documentation including design documents, SOPs and deployment guides.
  • Ability to lead technical workstreams and contribute to infrastructure projects from design through to delivery.
Highly Desirable Skills
  • Experience with secure network environments, secure web gateways and secure email gateways.
  • Knowledge of Australian Government security frameworks including PSPF and ISM.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Cisco networking technologies
    • Palo Alto or Fortinet firewalls
    • F5 load balancing technologies
    • Virtualisation platforms and enterprise server infrastructure
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Python or similar technologies.
What We're Looking For The ideal candidate will be a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer, Network Engineer or Network Security Engineer who enjoys working in complex enterprise environments and delivering secure, reliable ICT services.
You will have strong stakeholder engagement skills, a collaborative approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high technical standards.

The applicant must be Australian Citizen with baseline clearance.

job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:
The Client 
Our client is a non-corporate Commonwealth department responsible for national health support systems.

Role 
 The team protects the integrity of Australia's system by identifying, preventing and addressing incorrect claiming, fraud and inappropriate practice, while also administering key regulatory functions. Within the team, the Risk Analysis and Systems Branch delivers the data, governance and analytical capabilities that support effective compliance outcomes and informed decision making.

As part of the Branch, the Risk Analytics Section uses advanced analytics, intelligence and data-driven solutions to identify emerging risks, support investigations, improve access to information, and strengthen compliance activities across the Division. The Section develops and maintains risk detection models, data visualisation products, self-service reporting tools, data-matching capabilities, and data sharing pipelines. It ensures accurate, timely and governed delivery of data through ICT delivery partners, while driving growth of data and analytics capability across the team.

Responsibilities
  • Lead engagement with business and technical stakeholders to define, validate, document and prioritise business requirements, user stories, features and acceptance criteria. Facilitate user-centred design, co-design workshops and consultations to ensure analytical solutions, applications and business processes align with strategic and operational objectives.
  • Lead the analysis, design, documentation and continuous improvement of current and future-state business processes, ensuring solutions improve operational effectiveness, support organisational change and establish consistent practices across the Division
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language, enabling informed decision-making across diverse stakeholder groupsTesting, Solution Assurance and Delivery Support
  • Oversee user acceptance testing activities, including the development of testing strategies, validation frameworks, test scenarios and business sign-off processes.
  • Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards and operational needs prior to implementation and support the successful transition of solutions into business operations.
  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders across all APS levels, ICT delivery partners and external providers.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations, workshops, briefings and written communications tailored to stakeholder needs and communication preferences.

  • Utilise digital and manual platforms, including DevOps, Microsoft 365 and other business tools, to document, prioritise and manage business requirements, user stories, features and product backlogs.

  • Lead complex engagement with ICT delivery partners to ensure delivered ICT solutions, technical documentation and supporting artefacts are fit-for-purpose and aligned with approved business requirements.
  • Act as the key liaison between business and technical teams, facilitating collaboration and ensuring business needs are fully understood and represented throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Lead complex work programs and project streams by planning and scheduling activities, managing risks, issues, dependencies and competing priorities, and contributing to governance processes and status reporting. Collaborate with project teams to identify and implement mitigation strategies, support decision-making and ensure successful project outcomes.

Drive continuous improvement in business analysis practices, documentation standards, stakeholder engagement and delivery methodologies to support organisational capability uplift and sustainable outcomes.

  • Highly developed stakeholder engagement, facilitation and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships, manage competing priorities and achieve consensus across diverse business and technical stakeholder groups.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and work programs, fostering collaboration, driving outcomes and providing guidance and support to team members in complex and changing environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain governance frameworks, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure solutions meet business requirements, organisational standards and quality assurance expectations.
  • Strong capability to analyse and redesign business processes, lead change initiatives and drive continuous improvement to enhance operational effectiveness, user experience and organisational capability.
  • Ability to apply sound judgement to complex and ambiguous issues, identify practical solutions, evaluate options and provide evidence-based recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
  • Demonstrated understanding of technology-enabled business transformation, including analytical, reporting and digital solutions, with the ability to bridge business and technical perspectives to deliver sustainable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through change, identify opportunities for innovation and continuously improve processes, governance and service delivery in response to evolving business needs.
  • Leads the successful delivery of business analysis and project outcomes, ensuring requirements, deliverables and implementation activities are completed to agreed scope, quality and timeframes.

job.title: Lead AI Research Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Lead AI Research Engineer to join a high-impact research and technology program focused on developing advanced AI capabilities to support operational decision-making in a sensitive and highly regulated environment. This opportunity combines cutting-edge machine learning research with real-world deployment, offering the chance to design, build and evaluate AI solutions that address complex operational challenges.

About the Role

As the Lead AI Research Engineer, you will lead the design, development and operational evaluation of a secure human-in-the-loop AI system. Working closely with researchers, technical specialists and key stakeholders, you will translate complex operational requirements into practical and deployable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, applied research, software engineering and stakeholder engagement within a mission-critical environment.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the design and development of AI and machine learning solutions supporting complex operational requirements
  • Develop and implement multimodal AI capabilities leveraging computer vision, natural language processing, audio analysis and similarity detection techniques
  • Design, build and maintain secure, reproducible data processing, model training and evaluation pipelines
  • Develop deployable software components suitable for secure and restricted environments
  • Work closely with stakeholders to translate business and operational requirements into technical solutions and delivery outcomes
  • Establish evaluation frameworks and testing methodologies to validate model performance, reliability and usability
  • Conduct model assurance, adversarial testing and risk assessments
  • Ensure solutions align with privacy, security, governance and responsible AI principles
  • Prepare technical documentation, evaluation reports and deployment recommendations
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring and guidance across project teams and stakeholders
Skills & Experience:
  • Proven experience designing, developing and delivering AI and machine learning solutions beyond proof-of-concept into operational environments
  • Strong expertise in at least two of the following: computer vision, image/video classification, natural language processing, multimodal AI, similarity search, perceptual hashing or audio analysis
  • Advanced Python development skills and hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch
  • Experience building reproducible data pipelines, model training workflows, evaluation frameworks and deployable software solutions
  • Strong understanding of machine learning performance metrics, including precision, recall, calibration, uncertainty management and class imbalance challenges
  • Experience developing AI solutions within sensitive, regulated or security-conscious environments
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex operational requirements into scalable technical outcomes
  • Strong knowledge of responsible AI, security, privacy, human oversight and governance frameworks
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and technical leadership skills
  • Proven ability to independently lead complex technical projects and deliver outcomes against agreed milestones
  • Active NV1 (or higher) security clearance
Highly Desirable:
  • PhD or equivalent research experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science or related disciplines
  • Experience within law enforcement, defence, national security, digital forensics or other high-trust operational environments
  • Experience deploying AI solutions within on-premises, isolated or restricted-network environments
  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, decision-support tools or safety-critical AI applications
  • Published research, technical papers, patents or significant AI product delivery experience
What's on Offer?
  • 12-month contract with extension options
  • Opportunity to work on innovative AI and machine learning initiatives with real-world impact
  • Exposure to advanced computer vision, NLP and multimodal AI technologies
  • Collaborative environment involving researchers, technical specialists and senior stakeholders
  • Significant autonomy and ownership across the full AI solution lifecycle
  • Opportunity to contribute to applied research, capability development and emerging technologies
